			modifier = oe_eln_mod_parl_breakwater

			mode = replace
		}
		change_gold_effect_bounded = { scale = -4.0 min = 40 max = 800 }
		save_temporary_scope_as = oe_eln_parl_host
		location:chesapeake = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_owner = yes owner = scope:oe_eln_parl_host }
				change_development = 0.5
			}
		}
		location:nansemond = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_owner = yes owner = scope:oe_eln_parl_host }
				change_prosperity = 0.10
			}
		}
	}

	on_debate_failed = {
		parliament_debate_failed_effect = yes
	}
}
